SELECT
FROM wms_sales_outbound_order o LEFT JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = o.erp_tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant op ON op.id = t.parent_wms_tenant_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id WHERE o.id = #{id}
